transformations: Parsed the pinned UTF-8 CSV with strict header and column-count checks.
Parsed date as a date-only ISO value; no timezone or timestamp was invented.
Parsed PM2.5 as a finite number; original unit µg/m³ retained without conversion.
Retained blank PM2.5 source values as blank normalized values with missing_pm25_value quality flags.
Assigned source_record_key from data-record ordinal because publisher supplies no record ID.
Set city from publisher dataset title; station_id is blank because no station ID is published in the declared schema.
Rejected invalid records are written to quality/rejected_records.csv with original parsed fields and reason.
No imputation, deduplication, aggregation, or cross-source join was performed.
Gold row_id is SHA-256 of source_id, pinned version, and source_record_key.

source_level_issues.reason: The source ends before the configured freshness threshold; acquisition time does not make old observations current.
The source schema contains no station identifier, coordinates, or instrument identifier.
PAQI describes a monitoring network but does not specify per-day monitor count or aggregation rule.
The source has date-only values; the exact 24-hour window and timezone are not specified.
Calibration, validation, QA/QC thresholds, and maintenance history are not documented in inspected source materials.
The publisher does not explain what blank PM2.5 cells mean or how incomplete days were handled.

decisions.FIX: Apply only a deterministic representation normalization while preserving the exact original value.
decisions.FILL: No target imputation in this phase; record not_applied and preserve the missing label.
decisions.FLAG: Retain the issue for review; do not silently correct, drop, or fabricate data.
